officialEvidence.currentAccessModel: The current official SWG E-Tanken page states that all SWG charging points and connected partners are available through the E-Tanken app; current prices are displayed per connected charging point in the app. Registration creates an electromobility contract and payment is by SEPA direct debit.

historicalDirectEvidenceRejected: Older third-party records describe a spontaneous web/QR tariff, but the current official SWG page does not publish a numeric 2026 direct/ad-hoc matrix. Historical values are therefore not reused.
decision: No network-wide direct price is assigned. Current official evidence explicitly points to point-specific prices in the app, so exact pricing requires station/EVSE-level extraction. Defer deeper app/backend resolution until after breadth-first traversal.
nextAfterTraversal: Enumerate SWG-owned EVSEs from BNetzA/Mobilithek and capture current E-Tanken prices per point through public/guest surfaces if available without authentication bypass.
